svg.title: BCBC 2024 · 9.26.6.1 Materials
svg.text: BCBC 2024 · DIVISION B · PART 9 HOUSING AND SMALL BUILDINGS · SECTION 9.26 ROOFING
Except as required in Sentence (2), when
underlay is used beneath shingles, it is
not less than 0.195 kg/m² (0.040 lb/ft²), or (b)
Underlay used beneath wood shingles is
Drawn: rolls and sheets are generic, perforations in B are illustration only. Mass converted at 1 kg/m² = 0.2048 lb/ft².
